name: Kathmandu
summary: Nepal's capital: ancient durbar squares, Swayambhunath, Pashupatinath, Boudhanath and the gateway to Himalayan treks.
season_note: October-November and March-April have clear skies and good mountain views. June-September is monsoon; December-January is cold.
avoid_note: Monsoon brings landslides and cloud that hides mountains.
entry_note: Nepal: Bangladeshi passport holders can usually get a visa on arrival at Tribhuvan airport (fee and conditions apply) or apply at the embassy. Check the latest rules with the embassy before booking.

reach.how: Dhaka to Tribhuvan International Airport (Biman, US-Bangla, Nepal Airlines)
reach.note: Direct flights (Biman, Nepal Airlines, US-Bangla); about 1h45m.

reach.how: Dhaka to Kakarbhitta (Banglabandha-Panitanki-Kakarbhitta) then bus to Kathmandu
reach.note: Long overland route with several border formalities.

local.note: Insist on meter or agree first.

attractions.name: Pashupatinath Temple
attractions.what: A major Hindu temple complex on the Bagmati; cremation ghats.
attractions.tip: Non-Hindus can see only from the outside courtyards; stay respectful.

attractions.name: Boudhanath Stupa
attractions.what: One of the largest Buddhist stupas in the world.
attractions.tip: Walk clockwise; cafes with stupa view.

attractions.name: Swayambhunath (Monkey Temple)
attractions.what: Hilltop stupa with city views and monkeys.
attractions.tip: Climb stairs early; watch bags from monkeys.

attractions.name: Kathmandu Durbar Square
attractions.what: Royal palaces and temples; partly damaged by the 2015 earthquake.

attractions.name: Bhaktapur Durbar Square
attractions.what: A medieval city of brick and carved wood.

attractions.name: Thamel
attractions.what: Tourist lanes with trekking shops, cafes and souvenirs.

attractions.name: Nagarkot Sunrise
attractions.what: Hill station with Himalayan sunrise view.

rules: Remove shoes and avoid leather in temples; walk clockwise around stupas.
Non-Hindus not allowed in some inner sanctums.
